name: EXIFify
author: Kasuga

sections.description:
EXIFify quickly scans your entire media library in one click, verifying that no EXIF metadata (GPS location, date/time, camera model, etc.) slips through and removing any it finds from JPEG, PNG, and WebP images. It also automatically strips metadata on every upload.

Key features:

  • Pure binary parsing — no external tools or PHP extensions required, and blazing fast
  • Zero quality loss — no re-encoding
  • Auto-remove on upload (toggle on/off)
  • Bulk scan and clean your entire media library in one click
  • EXIF status visible at a glance in the media library
  • Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “EXIFify” and click Install Now
  3. Activate the plugin, then go to Tools > EXIFify to configure
  4. Run a one-click scan to clean EXIF metadata from your existing media library.
